content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record lists 15 alleged incidents and states the Agency's conclusion that Complainant 'failed to show that she was subjected to disparate treatment,' but no evidence, findings per incident, or reasoning links the allegations to that conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"gap","note":"Every incident is stated as an allegation with no identified source (affidavit, witness statement, document), and the Agency's findings are not attributed to any cited evidence in the ROI."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Most allegations carry specific dates (e.g., December 24, 2019; January 16, 2020) and the complaint filing date of April 13, 2020 is given, but the Light Duty start and end dates, the EEO contact timeline, and the dates of the investigation and decision are not documented."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who made the final decision, what legal standard or criteria were applied beyond the generic 'disparate treatment' reference, or whether Supervisor responses or articulated reasons were considered; the only process detail is the hearing election under 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b)."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because the conclusion cannot be traced, sources are unidentified, and the decision process is undocumented, an independent reviewer could not assess whether the finding of no discrimination is supported without the full ROI and decision."}}}
